system.description:
• Effect: Once per week, as your action, touch one creature.
    • It makes a Will save against your Class Save DC.
    • On a failure, every charm, curse, enchantment and possession on it ends and lycanthropy is cured; a fiend or undead is destroyed if its Level is no more than half your Paladin level, and otherwise takes radiant damage equal to twice your Paladin level and is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
    • On a success it takes half that damage.
    • Either way you learn its Allegiance and any charm, curse or possession on it, and you gain one level of Exhaustion.

activities.name: Cleanse Soul damage
activities.text: A fiend or undead too high in Level to destroy takes this (half on a success).
